0 dBm = 1 mW，每 +10 dBm 功率 ×10，故 30 dBm =: 0 dBm = 1 mW and every +10 dBm multiplies the power by 10, so 30 dBm = 1 W.
1 单一数字信道、2 数字、3 单路模拟。: 1 single digital channel, 2 digital, 3 single-channel analogue.
10 MHz 以上惯例使用 LSB（下边带）。: Above 10 MHz the convention is LSB (lower sideband).
10 MHz 以上惯例使用 USB（上边带），以下用 LSB。: Above 10 MHz the convention is USB (upper sideband); below it, LSB.
10 倍功率是 +10 dB，100 倍才是 +20 dB。: 10× power is +10 dB; only 100× is +20 dB.
12.5 / 25 kHz，抗干扰强，用于 VHF/UHF 本地。: 12.5 / 25 kHz; strong against interference, used for local VHF/UHF.
30 MHz 以下 <15 W 或 30 MHz 以上 ≤ 25 W。: Below 30 MHz < 15 W, or above 30 MHz ≤ 25 W.
30 MHz 以下 ≤ 1000 W 或 30 MHz 以上 ≤ 25 W。: Below 30 MHz ≤ 1000 W, or above 30 MHz ≤ 25 W.
40 米波段惯例使用 LSB。: The 40 m band conventionally uses LSB.
40m 在 10 MHz 以下，惯例使用 LSB（下边带）。: 40 m lies below 10 MHz, so the convention is LSB (lower sideband).
7 MHz 对应 40 米波段。: 7 MHz corresponds to the 40 m band.
A / B / C 三类各自频段与功率上限容易记混。: The bands and power limits of classes A / B / C are easy to confuse.
A = 幅度调制，1 = 数字，A = 电报；A1A 是等幅电报（CW）。: A = amplitude modulation, 1 = digital, A = telegraphy; A1A is continuous-wave telegraphy (CW).
A 只在 VHF/UHF；B/C 可上 HF，C 功率上限最高。: A is VHF/UHF only; B/C may use HF, and C has the highest power limit.
A 幅度、F 频率、G 相位、J 单边带抑制载波。: A amplitude, F frequency, G phase, J single sideband with suppressed carrier.
A 电报、B 数据传输、E 电话、F 电视。: A telegraphy, B data transmission, E telephony, F television.
A 类仅限 30–3000 MHz；B/C 类才可上 HF。: Class A is limited to 30–3000 MHz; only classes B/C may use HF.
A 类操作证可以在 30 MHz 以下发射。: A Class A licence may transmit below 30 MHz.
A1A、J3E、F3E 这类 ITU 发射类别记不住每位的含义。: Hard to remember what each character of ITU emission designators such as A1A, J3E and F3E means.
AM / SSB / FM / CW 各自带宽与用途容易记串。: The bandwidths and uses of AM / SSB / FM / CW are easy to mix up.
C 类操作证在 30 MHz 以下的功率上限是 1000 W。: Class C has a power limit of 1000 W below 30 MHz.
C 类：30 MHz 以下 ≤ 1000 W，30 MHz 以上 ≤ 25 W。: Class C: ≤ 1000 W below 30 MHz, ≤ 25 W above 30 MHz.
FM 的带宽通常比 CW 宽。: FM is usually wider than CW.
J = 单边带抑制载波，3 = 单路模拟，E = 电话。: J = single sideband with suppressed carrier, 3 = single-channel analogue, E = telephony.
J3E = 单边带·单路模拟·电话；A1A = 幅度·数字·电报。: J3E = single sideband · single-channel analogue · telephony; A1A = amplitude · digital · telegraphy.
P = U × I；每 +10 dBm 功率 ×10。: P = U × I; every +10 dBm multiplies the power by 10.
SSB 约 2.7 kHz，AM 约 6 kHz，SSB 更窄。: SSB is about 2.7 kHz and AM about 6 kHz, so SSB is narrower.
dBi = dBd + 2.15 dB；dBm 是绝对值，dB/dBi/dBd: dBi = dBd + 2.15 dB; dBm is an absolute value, while dB / dBi / dBd are ratios.
dBi 以理想点源为基准，dBd 以半波振子为基准，两者相差 2.15 dB。: dBi is referenced to an ideal point source and dBd to a half-wave dipole; they differ by 2.15 dB.
dBi 比 dBd 大 2.15 dB。: dBi is 2.15 dB greater than dBd.
dBm 以 1 mW 为 0 dB 基准，0 dBm = 1 mW。: dBm takes 1 mW as the 0 dB reference, so 0 dBm = 1 mW.
dBm 是一个无量纲的比值单位。: dBm is a dimensionless ratio unit.
dBm 是以 1 mW 为基准的绝对功率电平，不是比值。: dBm is an absolute power level referenced to 1 mW, not a ratio.
两个功率比值的对数单位，无量纲，只表示倍率关系。: A logarithmic unit for the ratio of two powers; dimensionless, expressing only a ratio.
两个电容并联，总电容等于两者之和。: Two capacitors in parallel: the total capacitance is their sum.
两个电阻并联，总电阻等于两者之和。: Two resistors in parallel: the total resistance is their sum.
以 1 mW 为基准的绝对功率电平，如 30 dBm = 1 W。: An absolute power level referenced to 1 mW; e.g. 30 dBm = 1 W.
分不清哪个是「相对比值」、哪个是「绝对电平」、哪个是「天线增益」。: Which one is a relative ratio, which an absolute level, and which an antenna gain — hard to keep apart.
到底 10 MHz 以上用 USB 还是 LSB 总是记反。: Whether USB or LSB is used above 10 MHz is always remembered the wrong way round.
功率增加一倍，约等于 +3 dB。: Doubling the power is about +3 dB.
功率翻倍对应多少 dB、10 倍对应多少 dB 记不牢。: How many dB a doubling or a tenfold increase of power is — hard to memorise.
发射类别 J3E 表示单边带电话。: The emission designator J3E means single-sideband telephony.
口诀：下（低频）用 LSB，上（高频）用 USB。: Mnemonic: low (lower frequencies) uses LSB, high (higher frequencies) uses USB.
天线增益，相对半波振子（偶极天线）。: Antenna gain relative to a half-wave dipole.
天线增益，相对理想点源（各向同性辐射体）。: Antenna gain relative to an ideal point source (isotropic radiator).
如 20m、15m、10m，惯例使用 USB（上边带）。: Such as 20 m, 15 m and 10 m; the convention is USB (upper sideband).
如 80m、40m，惯例使用 LSB（下边带）。: Such as 80 m and 40 m; the convention is LSB (lower sideband).
带宽从小到大：CW < SSB < AM < FM。: Bandwidth from narrowest to widest: CW < SSB < AM < FM.
Bandwidth from narrowest to widest: CW (100–300 Hz) < SSB < AM < FM (12.5/25 kHz).
带宽最窄，约 100–300 Hz，弱信号能力强。: Narrowest bandwidth, about 100–300 Hz; very capable with weak signals.
振子横放是水平极化（电场水平），竖放才是垂直极化。: A horizontal element gives horizontal polarisation (horizontal field); only vertical mounting gives vertical polarisation.
振子水平放置时是垂直极化。: With the element horizontal, the polarisation is vertical.
收发极化不一致时会产生显著损耗。: Mismatched polarisation between the two stations causes significant loss.
水平极化和垂直极化如何判断。: How to tell horizontal from vertical polarisation.
波长与频率成反比：λ(m) = 300 ÷ f(MHz)。: Wavelength is inversely proportional to frequency: λ(m) = 300 ÷ f(MHz).
瓦特、毫瓦、dBm 与电压、电流之间的关系。: The relationships between watts, milliwatts, dBm, voltage and current.
电场方向与地面垂直（振子垂直放置）。: The electric field is perpendicular to the ground (element mounted vertically).
电场方向与地面平行（振子水平放置）。: The electric field is parallel to the ground (element mounted horizontally).
电容与电阻的串并联规律正好相反，最容易错。: Capacitors follow exactly the opposite rule to resistors — the most common mistake.
电容串并联与电阻相反，电感与电阻相同。: Capacitors are the opposite of resistors; inductors behave like resistors.
电容并联相加（与电阻相反），串联则倒数相加。: Capacitors in parallel add (opposite to resistors); in series the reciprocals add.
电阻 / 电容 / 电感串并联: Resistors / capacitors / inductors in series and parallel
电阻串联才是相加；并联总电阻小于任一支路。: Only resistors in series add; in parallel the total is smaller than any branch.
看振子摆放方向：横着是水平极化，竖着是垂直极化。: Look at how the element is mounted: horizontal is horizontal polarisation, vertical is vertical polarisation.
约 2.7 kHz，功率利用率约为 AM 的 4 倍。: About 2.7 kHz; power efficiency about 4× that of AM.
约 6 kHz，含载波和上下两个边带。: About 6 kHz, including the carrier and both sidebands.
给频率算波长、给波长算频率时方向会搞反。: It's easy to invert the direction when converting frequency to wavelength and back.
频率越高波长越短，二者成反比。: The higher the frequency, the shorter the wavelength — they are inversely proportional.
频率越高，波长越长。: The higher the frequency, the longer the wavelength.
